task.title: Check a grocery GST bill, find the mistakes and reply to the customer
task.brief: Take about 15 minutes. Read the bill and the customer's message in the material. All rates are before GST. Part 1: List each mistake on the bill. For each one, write what is wrong and the correct figure (amounts, GST, totals). Then write the correct grand total and how much extra the customer paid. Part 2: Write a short, polite WhatsApp reply (4 to 6 lines) to Mr. Arjun Rao. Say sorry, explain the mistake in simple words, tell him the correct amount, and say how and when he will get the extra money back. You can write in English, Telugu or Hindi.
task.material:
TAX INVOICE - Sai Durga Super Market, Gandhi Road, Vijayawada (GSTIN 37XXXXX1234X1Z5)
Bill No: SDM/2611/0482   Date: 14-11-2026   Customer: Mr. Arjun Rao   Paid by: UPI

No | Item               | Qty | Rate (₹) | Amount (₹) | GST
1  | Sunflower oil 1 L  |  2  |   160    |    320     | 5%
2  | Rice 5 kg bag      |  1  |   350    |    350     | 5%
3  | Bath soap 125 g    |  4  |    45    |    200     | 18%
4  | Biscuits pack      |  5  |    20    |    100     | 18%

Sub-total (before GST):                  ₹970.00
CGST 2.5% on ₹670:                        ₹16.75
SGST 2.5% on ₹670:                        ₹16.75
CGST 18% on ₹300:                         ₹54.00
SGST 18% on ₹300:                         ₹54.00
Grand total (rounded):                 ₹1,112.00
Amount received (UPI):                 ₹1,112.00

Customer message (WhatsApp, next day):
"Hi, I bought groceries yesterday. The bill felt too high. Please check and tell me. - Arjun"
key_points: Soap amount is wrong: 4 x ₹45 = ₹180, not ₹200
Correct sub-total is ₹950 (₹670 at 5% and ₹280 at 18%)
18% GST must be split as CGST 9% + SGST 9%, not 18% each
Correct 18% GST: ₹25.20 CGST + ₹25.20 SGST on ₹280 (₹50.40 in all)
Reply says sorry, explains simply, and offers a refund of ₹78 back to his UPI with a clear time
Mentions a corrected bill or credit note will be shared

rubric.label: Correct figures
rubric.guide: 0 = mistakes not found or wrong numbers; 3 = finds some mistakes but total or refund is wrong; 5 = all mistakes found, correct total ₹1,034 and refund ₹78

rubric.label: Completeness
rubric.guide: 0 = only one part answered; 3 = both parts but missing the refund method or a corrected bill; 5 = every mistake listed with the fix, and the reply covers sorry, amount, refund and timing

rubric.label: Tone with the customer
rubric.guide: 0 = rude, blaming or defensive; 3 = polite but cold or no apology; 5 = warm, apologetic, respectful and reassuring

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = confusing, hard to follow; 3 = understandable but messy or too long; 5 = short, clear, easy for the customer to understand
